title: Corner Cafe
story: A neighbourhood cafe tracks its regular customers and their orders in two connected tables.
schemaSql: CREATE TABLE customers (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL); CREATE TABLE orders (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, customer_id INTEGER, item TEXT NOT NULL, amount REAL NOT NULL);
